decisions.reason: The modular waste processing concept builds on the firm's core offer and is backed by a quantified customer saving of over 600,000 euros per year, so it is a strong reference product worth keeping.
A mobile slow-speed shredder is a core product category for the firm, has its own page on the website and fits a growing market, so dropping it is very unlikely.
This multi-model product line is presented as the flagship of the firm's modular, cleaner-technology direction, so the firm will continue to invest in it.
Mobile trommel screens are an established staple of the firm's recycling portfolio and complement its shredders and modular plants.
